key_notes: Key 1 (t=2.04s): Initial archival pose of ladder; Quick, Draw! + Rotoscope centerline established.
Key 2 (t=3.17s): Mid-sequence articulation of ladder; 2x2 smooth cage tracks primary motion.
Key 3 (t=4.4s): Peak dynamic extension of ladder over 7-plane multiplane environment.
Key 4 (t=5.64s): Follow-through and settle of ladder with watertight SAM cel backing.
why_continuous: Continuous 3.6s archival shot of ladder (2.04s..5.64s) selected by edge clarity and temporal coherence.
